row.evidence: PartnerStack documents SAML 2.0 SSO for company teammates ("PartnerStack functions as the Service Provider") but no SCIM endpoint; teammates are invited and removed by hand under Settings > Teammates.
row.notes: New row. Quote-only: Launch, Growth and Enterprise are all 'Book your demo' with pricing set by program size, features and support; unlimited internal users. SAML 2.0 SSO is documented for company teammates (setup through PartnerStack support, which names Okta and OneLogin), with no plan stated, so sso_plan is null. No SCIM in the docs (llms.txt index), API reference or help centre; teammates are invited, given roles and removed manually. The Vendor API (Basic auth, public/private key) covers partners, customers, deals, rewards and webhooks; its member endpoints manage partner-side teams, not vendor teammates, so user_api_available is false. 'None' is by absence (rule 5).

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint in the docs index (docs.partnerstack.com/llms.txt, 0 matches for SCIM), the API reference or the help centre (Zendesk search for scim/provisioning/okta returns nothing). 'false' is by absence (rule 5).

auth.notes: Basic auth with the public key as username and private key as password (Vendor API page); OAuth2 delegation also exists for integrators.

rate_limits.text: 4000 requests per minute per IP address; 429 when exceeded.

user_api.notes: The Vendor API manages partners, partnerships, customers, deals, leads, rewards, exports and webhooks. 'Retrieve a partner team' and 'Invites or Adds a Partner Member' act on partner organisations' teams, not on the vendor's own teammates; no teammate list/invite/remove endpoint is in the reference index.

okta.notes: Vendor docs name Okta as a supported SAML IdP; okta.com/integrations/partnerstack/ returns 404, so catalogue listing is unknown.

google.notes: Google OAuth sign-in is supported, which is social login, not a catalogue app.

onelogin.notes: Vendor docs name OneLogin as a supported SAML IdP.
